newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates rise due to t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates rise due to t-bills.

text.p: The average overnight interbank rate on the Egyptian pound rose in a short private-sector market on Monday to between 8-1/2 and 9-1/2 percent from Sunday's range of 8-1/2 to 8-3/4 percent, bankers said.
They said the shortage was mainly due to treasury bill auctions, which have been withdrawing liquidity from the market for the past three weeks.
The latest offer on Monday was for 1.1 billion pounds in 91-day bills in Wednesday's auction, to replace bills worth 665.3 million maturing on Thursday.
Bankers said there were no one-week deals. Sunday's range was 7-3/4 and 8-1/2 percent.

Bankers said public-sector banks were now lowering their official minimum lending rate to around 9-1/2 percent from the long-standing rate of 10-1/2 percent. The new level has not been officially announced.
